identification: Framed map titled 'Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania' (title cartouche readable in photo), Tallis/Rapkin style with Greek key border, scroll corners and vignettes, printed in pale blue-green tone with faint colour. Imprint at foot too small to read. Could be an original c1851 Tallis steel engraving that has lost its hand colour, or a modern reproduction. In a burr-effect modern frame with glass.

viewing_check: Read the imprint at the foot (should say 'Engraved by J. Rapkin' / 'London Printed & Published by John Tallis & Co'); look for plate mark, paper toning and foxing, and whether the print is on laid/thin 1850s paper with hand colour (original) versus crisp modern dot-screen printing on bright white paper (reproduction). Check whether the back has a modern backing board.
